experiment: BSAM vs Plain MSE equal-training-time paired seeds
timing_scope: data preparation, model forward/backward and optimizer step, synchronized GPU; excludes Validation, checkpoint I/O and initial data loading
seed_order: seed*101+epoch, matching historical 4343/4444/4545 order seeds plus epoch
bsam: Train-only inverse-square-root 10-Mg/ha bin weights; rho=0.2; weighted first pass, unweighted second pass; BN running statistics updated only in first pass
plain: unweighted center-pixel MSE, one forward/backward pass per update
validation_nodes: all completed epochs and final partial-budget node
checkpoint_rule: lowest full Validation Overall RMSE among nodes within training-time budget
same_update_comparison: only actual common completed update nodes; no interpolation
